name: City Shuttle · Round 1
domainSummary: A short low-floor urban shuttle distinguished by a broad passenger body, generous accessible door zones, a compact civic wheelbase, clear wheel arches, and restrained roof climate equipment.
evidenceBoundary: Keep the shuttle generic and unowned. Do not imply a transit authority, route, destination, passenger state, accessibility certification, or real production model.

researchSources.title: Career World ambient expansion inventory
researchSources.use: Accepted shuttle role and canonical map-scale baseline added for the living-world tournament library.

researchSources.title: Tournament production ledger
researchSources.use: Canonical city-shuttle geometry and asset identity.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Canonical Production
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into its clearest production-ready map prop; emphasize low-floor passenger access
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested in its most resolved reusable form. This version emphasizes low-floor passenger access.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Silhouette Contrast
assets.controlledVariable: push the outer contour and negative spaces for instant recognition at map scale; emphasize broad doorway zones
assets.thesis: A distinct silhouette tests recognition without labels or color. This version emphasizes broad doorway zones.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Weighted Asymmetry
assets.controlledVariable: shift the dominant mass off-center while preserving the asset's practical balance; emphasize short urban wheelbase
assets.thesis: Controlled asymmetry creates identity without sacrificing function. This version emphasizes short urban wheelbase.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Functional Exposure
assets.controlledVariable: make the asset's defining working parts structurally legible without diagrams; emphasize roof climate equipment
assets.thesis: Exposed function tests whether the object reads through construction rather than decoration. This version emphasizes roof climate equipment.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Rugged Structure
assets.controlledVariable: strengthen load-bearing edges, joints, guards, and contact points; emphasize readable civic passenger body
assets.thesis: Rugged construction tests a durable working-world interpretation. This version emphasizes readable civic passenger body.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Modular Rhythm
assets.controlledVariable: organize repeated functional elements into a clear unequal rhythm on one coherent object or shared base; emphasize low-floor passenger access
assets.thesis: A modular cadence tests reuse and system belonging. This version emphasizes low-floor passenger access.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Low Profile
assets.controlledVariable: compress height and emphasize a long stable footprint while retaining every defining feature; emphasize broad doorway zones
assets.thesis: A low profile tests legibility in dense map placement. This version emphasizes broad doorway zones.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Vertical Accent
assets.controlledVariable: give one legitimate functional element a taller focal role while keeping the overall prop subordinate to buildings; emphasize short urban wheelbase
assets.thesis: A vertical accent tests landmark readability without turning the prop into architecture. This version emphasizes short urban wheelbase.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the asset to the smallest complete form that preserves its exact identity and component count; emphasize roof climate equipment
assets.thesis: The primitive reveals which cues are essential. This version emphasizes roof climate equipment.

assets.name: City Shuttle · Ambient Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance silhouette, function, construction, modular detail, and map-scale restraint in one production-ready prop; emphasize readable civic passenger body
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests the complete ambient identity for repeated world use. This version emphasizes readable civic passenger body.
